Package index

Reading posts

One request to the X API, saved whole as a frozen file you unfold later.

get_timeline()
Get User Timeline
get_recent_post()
Get Recent Post
get_recent_post_count()
Get Recent Post Count
get_post()
Get Post by IDs
get_quote_post()
Retrieve Quote Posts for a Given Post
get_repost()
Get Repost by ID
get_mentions()
Get User Mention Timeline
get_account_timeline()
Get User Account Timeline
get_bookmark()
Get Bookmark
get_liked_posts()
Get Own Liked Posts
get_liking_users()
Get Liking Users
get_repost_of_me()
Get Reposts of Me
iso_8601()
Convert a Date or Date-Time to ISO 8601 UTC Format

Unfolding a pull into tables

The twelve tables of the course’s data model, each from a saved pull. None of these calls the API.

extract_post()
Extract Post Data from Timeline
extract_user()
Extract User Data from Timeline
extract_post_media()
Extract Media Information from Timeline
extract_post_url()
Extract Post URL Information from Timeline
extract_post_mention()
Extract Post Mention Data from Timeline
extract_post_hashtag()
Extract Post Hashtag Data from Timeline
extract_post_cashtag()
Extract Post Cashtag Data from Timeline
extract_post_context()
Extract Post Context Data from Timeline
extract_post_entity_annotation()
Extract Post Entity Annotation Data from Timeline
extract_post_poll_option()
Extract Post Poll Option Information from Timeline
extract_post_place()
Extract Post Place and Geo Coordinates from Timeline
extract_post_edited_post_id()
Extract Post Edited Post ID from Timeline

Accounts and follows

Profiles by handle, id or search, and who follows, is followed by, reposts, blocks or mutes. Each returns the 24 user columns of extract_user().

get_users_by_usernames()
Get Users by Usernames
get_users_by_ids()
Get Users by IDs
search_users()
Search Users
get_followers()
Get Followers
get_following()
Get Following
get_reposted_by()
Get Reposted By
get_blocking()
Get Blocking
get_muting()
Get Muting
